sys_update_xml.payload: customc/* Colours come from the portal theme ($brand-primary, $text-color). */ .kbtree { position: sticky; top: 16px; max-height: calc(100vh - 32px); overflow-y: auto; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #d9dce1; border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 8px 12px 12px; font-size: 13px; } .kbtree-back { display: inline-block; color: $brand-primary; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 4px 8px 4px; } .kbtree-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; color: $text-color; padding: 0 4px 8px 4px; margin-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eef0f2; } .kbtree-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding-left: 12px; } .kbtree > .kbtree-list { padding-left: 0; } .kbtree-cat { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; width: 100%; background: none; border: 0; padding: 4px; text-align: left; font-weight: 600; color: $text-color; cursor: pointer; } .kbtree-cat .fa { font-size: 10px; width: 10px; opacity: .7; } .kbtree-cat:hover, .kbtree-art:hover { background: #f3f4f6; text-decoration: none; } .kbtree-art { display: block; padding: 4px 6px 4px 20px; color: $text-color; border-left: 3px solid transparent; text-decoration: none; } .kbtree-art.is-current { border-left-color: $brand-primary; background: #eef3fb; font-weight: 600; } .kbtree-empty { opacity: .7; padding: 4px; } sp_instanceDocumentation-style tree navigation (categories and articles) for one knowledge base.falsekb-tree-navigationfalseKB Tree Navigation[{"name": "kb_id", "label": "Knowledge base (used when the URL has no kb_id)", "type": "reference", "reference": "kb_knowledge_base"}, {"name": "article_page", "label": "Article page id", "type": "string", "default_value": "kb_tree_article"}, {"name": "home_page", "label": "Knowledge base list page id", "type": "string", "default_value": "kb_tree_home"}]falsefalsesp_widgetadmin2026-11-23 14:26:06694b7da42bbc57d4683df829fe91bf792KB Tree Navigationglobalglobalsp_widget_694b7da42bbc57d4683df829fe91bf79admin2026-11-23 14:45:54
